request_phase.name: first_request_to_last_response
request_phase.method: Request perf_counter timestamps mapped to wall time by mean of controller start/end clock offsets.

limitations: Totals count host forward-context extents, not every kernel execution.
Draft context wraps multiple MTP steps; its first-step token extent is not the sum of draft-model tokens.
Attention sequence lengths, custom arithmetic and MoE routed valid rows remain unaccounted.
Original request-window mismatch is retained; the tail is reported separately and not silently divided by request-only time.
No uninstrumented B1 performance replacement or M01 pass is claimed.
